note: Active matched-job reference set after t172 (2026-11-20). The port of canonical OrcaSlicer `v2.5.0` (`40ecc66f78`) `clipper.offset.cpp::OffsetConcaveCrossing` (with `.round()` integer conversion and AGPLv3 attribution header) into `vendor/clipper2-rust/src/offset.rs` joins concave corners directly at the edge-offset crossing instead of emitting 3-point concave loops for the finishing union to clip away. It is not output-neutral by construction: rounded crossing coordinates differ by <= 1 unit (100 nm) from union-clipped 3-point loops, moving all eight cells. The baseline arm reproduced t169's active set in 8/8 in the same campaign, and every candidate hash is byte-identical between the ordinary and accelerated arms (8/8 + 8/8). Superseded: every t169 hash.
